title: SBI overtakes TCS to become India's 4th Most Valuable Company
summary: SBI market cap crossed ₹10.9 lakh crore, surpassing TCS (₹10.5L Cr) to rank 4th (Reliance > HDFC Bank > Bharti Airtel > SBI).
